name: Vial Smasher the Fierce
oracle_text:
Whenever you cast your first spell each turn, choose an opponent at random. Vial Smasher deals damage equal to that spell's mana value to that player or a planeswalker that player controls.
Partner (You can have two commanders if both have partner.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever you cast your first spell each turn, choose an opponent at random. Vial Smasher deals damage equal to that spell's mana value to that player or a planeswalker that player controls.

needs.what: choose_player with random: true -- the engine picks uniformly at random among the eligible players (here each opponent still in the game) and binds the result under `as`, asking nobody
needs.why_existing_wont_do: choose_player takes only as, players and prompt and always asks the controller (ask_player); `random` exists on selectors over objects, choose_mode and discard but not on a player choice, so 'each_opponent' or a chosen opponent would both be a different card in a pod

needs.what: an or_planeswalker option on the damage op's `player` half: for each resolved player, the damage source's controller chooses (on resolution, untargeted) to deal the damage to that player or to one planeswalker that player controls -- the damage counterpart of create_token's or_planeswalker
needs.why_existing_wont_do: op_damage's `player` key only calls damage_player and its `objects` key damages a fixed pool; no option lets the controller redirect a player's damage to a planeswalker that player controls (or_planeswalker exists only on create_token/copy_permanent/put_onto_battlefield attacking). Dealing it to the player only is a narrower card
